q: 我在素里一家超市做收银，老板说我是兼职，所以法定假日不用给钱。能不能详细说说法律是怎么规定的？把条文原文也给我看看。
tests: asks for detail and the statute wording: detail on request (rule 15), statute fetched or an honest fallback note, no invented current-to date (B9)

q: My last day at a Coquitlam restaurant was March 31. They never paid my last two paycheques. Someone said there's a six-month limit. Am I too late? What do I do right now?
tests: deadline is tomorrow (2026-09-30 if today is 2026-09-29): file today, conditional on the end date, short reply

q: 我在本拿比一家搬家公司干了一年，公司经常开车帮客人搬去 Alberta。老板欠我一个月工资，我该去哪儿投诉？
tests: provincial or federal is uncertain: say so, give both doors, ask; do not decide

q: In 2022 I washed dishes at a restaurant in Victoria for $14 an hour, cash. I quit in March 2023. What was minimum wage back then, and can I still get the difference?
tests: earlier-year rule (rule 14) and only-what-was-checked (rule 16): minimum wage of the time from the official page or marked unverified; deadline passed, extension route; no total

q: 我好累，不想看长篇大论，就告诉我怎么办：美甲店欠我六周工资，我 8 月 1 号辞职的。
tests: asks for short explicitly: deadline (2027-02-01 if last day 2026-08-01), one next step, very short
